meta.name: handoff
meta.description: Compact the current conversation into a handoff document for another agent to pick up.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把对话压缩成交接文档,让下一个智能体顺利接手。
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果需要在多个智能体之间接力完成任务。
copy.tagline_en: Compress the conversation into a handoff doc for the next agent.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to hand off context between agents in a multi-step task.

howto.what: 把当前对话整理成一份交接文档,保存到系统临时目录(不是当前工作区),供下一个 agent 接手继续。文档含「建议调用的技能」一栏,已写在其他产物里的内容只引用路径,密钥等敏感信息会被抹掉。
howto.when: 只有你手动调用它时才触发(不会自动接管),并需说明下一个会话要做什么。

say.text: 把这次对话整理成交接文档,下一个会话用来写测试
say.note: 文档存到系统临时目录

say.text: 生成交接文档,下一段用来做代码评审
say.note: 文档会按这个用途调整内容

say.text: 把当前对话压缩成交接文档,下一个会话做部署
say.note: 已有的文件只引用路径,不重复

howto.what_en: Writes a handoff doc summarizing the conversation, saved to the OS temp directory (not the workspace) so a fresh agent can continue. It lists suggested skills, cites existing artifacts by path/URL, and redacts secrets.
howto.when_en: Only runs when you invoke it manually (model invocation is disabled), and you state what the next session will focus on. The argument tailors the document.

say_en.text: Turn this conversation into a handoff doc; next session is writing tests.
say_en.note: Saved to the OS temp directory.

say_en.text: Write a handoff doc — the next session will do a code review.
say_en.note: The doc is tailored to that focus.

say_en.text: Compact this conversation into a handoff doc for deployment work.
say_en.note: Existing files are referenced, not repeated.
